title: JavaScript Basics in the Browser
learning_objectives: Explain that JavaScript runs in the browser and manipulates web pages
Run simple scripts in the browser console and via a script tag
outline: Where JavaScript runs and what it can do in the browser
Hands-on: small interactive behavior added to the P1-L02 page

format: Small enhancement to previous HTML/CSS page using JavaScript
Short-answer questions about variables and conditionals

constraints_for_professor: Use only `<script>` tags and browser devtools
Keep examples short and focused on clarity, not cleverness
